Name: Rita's Northern Light Peak
Author: RitaEmiko
Description:
This is my third custom map. Choose the map in character creation menu. ﻿
This map is very spacious and beautiful. This time there's a mountain top view and waterfalls.
*Grandpa‘s shrine is located in a floating island
这是我第三个自制地图，在地图选择页面选择它即可。
这个地图很大且有着美丽的风景，包括山顶风景和瀑布景观。
*爷爷的神龛在左侧的浮空岛上。

The map has multiple areas separated for different purposes. Try to use and decorate as you please.There are also few warp stones for easy access. (If you are tired of the view)不同区域以不同功能划分，你可以自行设计装饰。地图上有多个传送石已方便你的出行（如果你不想看风景了的话）

I don't have much time for this game but I'm happy to hear if you have any questions or issues to report to. I'll get to it once I'm free.我不定期上线，如果有何反馈，我很乐意倾听并且在我有空的时候试着修改。

PS: Cave Location - bottom of the map.PS：农场洞穴在地图正下方。

Mod Required:
DaisyNiko's TilesheetsThis is needed because I can't find a good ladder and flowers from vanilla game﻿. Other than this everything should be vanilla.
